one_line: A named expert answers a seasonal question to the lens, and a free checklist is offered for a comment.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman at a kitchen table, smiling, a finger raised to the lens. Said (transcript): "אז איך נסדר את הקלמר? קבלו טיפ של מרפאה בעיסוק." Same subtitle, plus a name box: "מיכל שטורם / מרפאה בעיסוק לילדים".
q1_hook.why: A face, a voice and a direct seasonal question from the first second (H4, H1, F6), said and shown at once (H6, T3), with a credential box (T3). It is a question, not a promise of a result, and the product is absent until 0:10 (H2, S1).

beats.what: Smiling, finger raised; "אז איך נסדר את הקלמר?"; name box
beats.why: A question and a named expert.

beats.what: Many compartments, "לכל דבר יש מקום קבוע"; shows a blue denim pencil case at 0:10
beats.why: The first tip with a prop.

beats.what: Closer framing; weekly check; a checklist graphic appears at 0:30; "פינה בחדר"
beats.why: The independence habit, with one graphic.

beats.what: Cut to a shelf with a Giotto tub, supplies in the corner
beats.why: The only picture change in the first half.

beats.what: Back to her: "יותר חשוב בעיניי משולחן כתיבה לילד בכיתה א'"
beats.why: A bold comparison to restart attention.

beats.what: Holds up a Giotto Turbo Color 96 markers tub, then a pencil box (Lyra)
beats.why: Products with reasons, one marker of each colour.

beats.what: Holds up a pack of pastel erasers; "שיהיה פשוט ויפה"
beats.why: Third item, in the same frame.

beats.what: Subtitle: "כתבו לי אם תרצו שאשלח לכם את הצ'ק ליסט 👇"; she smiles to the end

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Subtitle 1:18 and caption: write to her to get the checklist ("כתבו לי", "הגיבו פה"), no fixed word. The caption invites a follow to her stories. Nothing asks to send it to a friend.
q2_flow.why: One continuous talk with a prop, a graphic at 0:30 and a shelf cut at 0:34 is thin on new picture for 83 s (R3, R1). The comparison at 0:37 and holding up the products re-engage attention (E2). A free checklist is worth a comment (R6). 83 s is long for one tip (R2).

q3_cta.what: Subtitle at about 1:18 to 1:21 (transcript does not include it): "כתבו לי אם תרצו שאשלח לכם את הצ'ק ליסט 👇". Caption: "ולמי לשלוח את הצ'ק ליסט לארגון הקלמר... הגיבו פה👇🏻" and "ובואו לסטורי".
q3_cta.why: A comment that delivers something real, a free checklist (C3, R6, C2), shown after the value (C6), but with no fixed word. A second ask, see her stories, is added in the caption (C1). The on-screen line sits in the bottom 35% and overlaps another subtitle at 1:18 (F2, T2).

q4_shown.what: A woman in a kitchen with a denim pencil case at 0:10, a checklist graphic at 0:30, a shelf with a Giotto tub at 0:34, a Giotto Turbo Color 96 tub from 0:44, a blue pencil box, pastel erasers. No child, price or product use.
q4_shown.why: The credential is on screen all through, and her own years of use are the only proof (S6). Items are held up one by one but never used (S1, F8). The brand appears at 0:34 and 0:44 as one of three picks, not the hero (H3, C7). No result or child shown.

q5_edit.what: 4 shots in 83 s, 21 s average: a 16.6 s take, a punch-in at 0:17, a 3 s shelf clip at 0:34, then 46 s of one framing with props. A checklist inset 0:30 to 0:32. Subtitles in step. Ends on her smile.
q5_edit.why: Subtitles in step carry the speech muted (E4, T1), but 46 s of one framing with few cuts leaves the pace to her delivery (E2, R3). Props add change but are held up only briefly (R3). It ends right after the ask (E8), yet 83 s is long (R2).

q6_topic.what: How to organise a first-grader's pencil case so the child restocks it alone, with three items an occupational therapist recommends. Serves a parent before school.
q6_topic.why: The school start is a dated buying moment and a real parent concern (K7, K6). The advice is concrete and modest, a habit and a checklist (K4), delivered warmly. No emotional peak (K1). The save-worthy checklist is held back for a comment (R7).

q7_filmed.what: Locked-off medium shot at eye level in a bright kitchen, a clip-on mic, a wooden table at the bottom of the frame. One cut to a shelf. She talks to the lens, holding items to the camera.
q7_filmed.why: Eye level, direct to the lens, window light: the native expert look (F6, H8, F7). Held-up boxes fill the lower frame and are readable (F4), but the subtitles cross the products at the bottom (F2). Full 9:16, sharp (F1, F3).

q8_text.on_screen: A name box mid-frame 0:00 to 0:04: "מיכל שטורם" / "מרפאה בעיסוק לילדים". White subtitles with a shadow, about 80% down, 1 to 2 lines, in step with the voice: "אז איך נסדר את הקלמר?" (0:00), "יותר חשוב בעיניי משולחן כתיבה" (0:39), "אנחנו משלימים את הצבע החסר" (0:51), "כתבו לי אם תרצו שאשלח לכם את הצ'ק ליסט 👇" (1:18). Checklist graphic 0:30.
q8_text.caption: "ידע שהוא זהב👆🏻✨️". About 35 words: the checklist offer with the comment ask, a pointer to her stories, her name and role, four hashtags (one a stray tag). No disclosure line.
q8_text.why: Near-verbatim subtitles work muted (T1) but fill the lower frame all through (T2, T4). The credential box (T3) is clear. The caption has a hook line, the checklist offer and specific hashtags (T7), but the Giotto partnership is not stated in words anywhere (S7, T8).

weak_points: 83 s on one framing; products held up but never used; the CTA overlaps a subtitle and has no fixed word; a second ask in the caption; partnership not stated in words; the checklist shown for 2 s.
lumebook_takeaway: Prop the phone at eye level, ask the parent's seasonal question in the first line, hold up the book briefly, and offer one free card for a comment word.
not_verified: Exact product names of the pencils and erasers (partly legible); whether the partnership was paid (a co-author is listed, no label, no word); the music (none evident); her stories. Corrections to the first pass: the name box sits mid-frame, not at the top, and the CTA subtitle overlaps the previous line at 1:18. Plays 4,282, likes 92, comments 74 on 15 Oct are context only. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
